title: What NewJeans-Infused Personality Type Are You?
description: Answer 12 questions to discover your NewJeans-infused personality type!

questions.text: When your favorite NewJeans song comes on in a public space, you...

options.text: Daydream about designing a whimsical dance routine to this song
Start singing along loudly and gesture for nearby friends to join you
Smile secretly and softly tap your foot to the beat under the table
Notice every subtle bass drop and layered vocal harmony in the track

questions.text: Your friend wants to plan a NewJeans-themed hangout, you suggest...

options.text: Create a strict schedule: 30 mins of dance practice, 20 mins of photo booth, 15 mins of snack time
Host a cozy movie night where you rewatch all their music videos and share your favorite moments
Go with the flow—start with listening to their album and let the day unfold naturally
Organize a trivia game with detailed questions about their lyrics and career milestones

questions.text: When you discover a new NewJeans B-side track, you...

options.text: Save it to your private playlist and listen to it repeatedly when you’re alone
Imagine how this track would fit into a coming-of-age story you’re writing in your head
Immediately send it to your group chat and beg everyone to react to it right away
Look up the song’s production credits and learn about the team behind it

questions.text: You’re asked to design a NewJeans-inspired gift for a friend, you...

options.text: Create a fictional storybook where your friend is a NewJeans member on an adventure
Buy high-quality items that match their favorite NewJeans era’s color scheme
Make a scrapbook filled with handwritten notes about how their music connects you two
Build a custom playlist generator that curates NewJeans tracks based on your friend’s mood

questions.text: When your group is debating which NewJeans song to perform at a school event, you...

options.text: Rally everyone to vote by doing a quick dance-off preview of each track
Stay quiet but take notes on everyone’s ideas before sharing your top choice
List pros and cons for each song and pick the one that’s easiest to choreograph quickly
Suggest combining elements from multiple songs to create a unique mashup

questions.text: After watching a NewJeans live performance, you find yourself thinking most about...

options.text: What kind of creative stage designs they could use for their next world tour
How smoothly they executed each dance move in sync with the backing track
The technical skill required to sing and dance at the same time without mistakes
How happy the members looked when interacting with the crowd

questions.text: When you’re feeling stressed, listening to NewJeans helps you by...

options.text: Providing a predictable, calming routine of your favorite tracks on repeat
Inspiring you to call a friend and dance to their songs together to cheer up
Giving you a quiet escape where you can process your feelings alone
Encouraging you to try new activities like learning their dances to distract yourself

questions.text: You find a NewJeans fan art online that you love, you...

options.text: Save it to your personal art folder and look at it when you need a pick-me-up
Comment a long, heartfelt message telling the artist how much their work means to you
Share it to your social media story and tag all your K-pop friends to see
Analyze the art’s composition and color theory and share your thoughts in a detailed post

questions.text: Your friend is upset because they missed a NewJeans fan meet, you...

options.text: Help them find a recorded version of the meet and plan a mini fan night to make up for it
Sit with them and listen to their feelings while playing their favorite NewJeans song softly
Create a fictional story where they’re the special guest at the next NewJeans event
Bring them their favorite snack and a printed photo of the members to cheer them up

questions.text: When planning a trip to visit NewJeans’ hometown city, you...

options.text: Pack light and decide to explore areas that remind you of their songs as you go
Book all accommodations and make a day-by-day itinerary of must-visit K-pop spots
Imagine yourself walking the streets and writing a song inspired by the city’s vibe
Research exact locations where their music videos were filmed and map out how to get there

questions.text: You’re asked to describe NewJeans’ music to someone who’s never heard it, you...

options.text: Compare it to the feeling of flipping through a nostalgic teen diary filled with joy and longing
Talk quietly about how their music feels like a warm hug on a bad day
Explain their unique blend of 90s R&B beats and modern K-pop production techniques
Play them a clip and start dancing to show the energy and fun of their tracks

questions.text: When you finish a NewJeans album marathon, you feel most inclined to...

options.text: Make a ranked list of your top 5 tracks from the album and share it with a friend
Start exploring similar 90s-inspired K-pop groups to discover new music
Text your best friend about how each song made you feel and what memories it brought back
Write a detailed review analyzing the album’s themes and production quality

results.title: Whimsical MV Visionary
results.description: Like the dreamy energy of 'Ditto', you’re a free-spirited visionary who sees magic in every moment. You love brainstorming playful, creative ideas with friends—like designing wild music video concepts for NewJeans tracks—and thrive on authentic, heartfelt connections. Your infectious joy draws people in, and you never shy away from embracing your quirky side. As an ENFP, you turn every listening session into an adventure.

results.title: Warm-hearted Fandom Leader
results.description: You’re the glue that holds your NewJeans fan group together, just like how the members support each other on stage. You remember every friend’s bias and favorite track, always going out of your way to make others feel seen. You organize fan meetups and share uplifting messages to spread positivity in the fandom. As an ENFJ, you lead with empathy and turn shared love for NewJeans into lasting bonds.

results.title: Witty Lyric Analyst
results.description: You’re the fan who dissects every NewJeans lyric to uncover hidden meanings, debating theories with others in lively online discussions. You love challenging traditional takes on their music, even proposing wild alternate universe concepts for their lore. Your quick wit and curiosity make you the life of any fandom conversation. As an ENTP, you turn every track into a puzzle to solve.

results.title: Strategic Fandom Planner
results.description: You’re the one who orchestrates perfect NewJeans-themed events, from detailed itinerary-driven fan trips to coordinated streaming parties that break records. You analyze streaming data to maximize the group’s chart performance and lead fandom projects with precision. As an ENTJ, you turn your love for NewJeans into organized, impactful action that moves the needle for the group.

results.title: Nostalgic Playlist Curator
results.description: NewJeans’ music takes you back to the tender moments of your youth, and you curate intimate playlists that capture those exact feelings. You write private poetry inspired by their lyrics, saving it in a journal you only share with your closest confidants. You value the quiet, emotional depth of their tracks more than any loud fanfare. As an INFP, you turn their music into a personal sanctuary.

results.title: Intuitive Lore Weaver
results.description: You see the deeper narrative threads in NewJeans’ music videos, connecting small details to craft a cohesive, emotional lore that resonates with others. You often meditate on how their music reflects universal themes of growth and belonging, sharing your insights in thoughtful, quiet conversations. As an INFJ, you turn their discography into a mirror for the human experience.

results.title: Curious Production Nerd
results.description: You’re the fan who obsesses over NewJeans’ production credits, researching every producer and sound engineer behind their tracks. You analyze the technical aspects of their beats and vocal layers, even experimenting with making your own covers that replicate their unique sound. You prefer deep dives into music theory over casual fan chatter. As an INTP, you turn their tracks into a masterclass in audio design.

results.title: Futuristic Fandom Strategist
results.description: You plan long-term fandom goals, like creating a comprehensive archive of NewJeans’ content or developing AI tools to predict their next creative direction. You approach being a fan with calculated precision, focusing on projects that have lasting impact rather than fleeting trends. As an INTJ, you turn your love for NewJeans into innovative, forward-thinking initiatives.

results.title: Vibrant Dance Enthusiast
results.description: You’re the first to learn every NewJeans dance, performing it at parties and public spaces with unapologetic energy. You love attending live shows and fan meets, feeding off the crowd’s excitement and connecting with fellow fans through shared dance moves. You live in the moment, turning every track into a celebration. As an ESFP, you’re the heart of any NewJeans fan gathering.

results.title: Caring Fan Supporter
results.description: You’re the fan who sends handwritten letters to NewJeans members, sharing how their music helped you through tough times. You organize care packages for fan projects and always check in on friends in the fandom who are feeling down. You prioritize community and kindness, making everyone feel welcome in the NewJeans family. As an ESFJ, you turn fandom into a safe, loving space.

results.title: Spontaneous Fan Adventurer
results.description: You’re the one who books last-minute tickets to NewJeans concerts, travels across cities to attend pop-up shops, and challenges friends to impromptu dance battles to their tracks. You love the thrill of unexpected fandom moments, preferring to dive into experiences rather than plan them. As an ESTP, you turn every NewJeans release into an excuse for a new adventure.

results.title: Organized Fandom Archivist
results.description: You maintain a detailed physical and digital archive of NewJeans’ photos, music, and interviews, categorizing every piece of content with precision. You create shared spreadsheets for fandom projects, ensuring everyone knows their role and deadlines are met. You value structure and tradition, keeping the fandom’s history alive for new fans to discover. As an ESTJ, you’re the keeper of NewJeans’ fandom legacy.

results.title: Gentle Artistic Fan
results.description: You express your love for NewJeans through quiet, creative acts—like painting fan art inspired by their soft aesthetics or writing acoustic covers of their songs. You prefer small, intimate listening sessions with one or two friends over large fan events, focusing on the sensory joy of their music. As an ISFP, you turn their tracks into beautiful, personal works of art.

results.title: Nurturing Bias Supporter
results.description: You know every detail about your NewJeans bias—from their favorite snack to their hidden talents—and go out of your way to support their solo endeavors. You create custom gift boxes for bias-themed events and always remember to wish them happy birthday. You’re the fan who prioritizes caring for individual members as much as the group. As an ISFJ, you turn your bias into a source of gentle, unwavering support.

results.title: Hands-On Cover Creator
results.description: You love taking apart NewJeans’ tracks to understand their production, then recreating them with your own twist using instruments or music software. You build custom merch like hand-painted tote bags with their logo, focusing on practical, unique items. You prefer doing hands-on fandom projects over talking about them. As an ISTP, you turn their music into tangible, creative creations.

results.title: Dedicated Streaming Champion
results.description: You have a strict daily streaming routine for NewJeans tracks, tracking every play to contribute to their chart success. You maintain a detailed log of all their releases, from debut to latest B-sides, and follow official fan guidelines to ensure your support is effective. You value consistency and reliability, being the backbone of the fandom’s streaming efforts. As an ISTJ, you turn your dedication into measurable results.
